key: Powdered spores drip from the strange plant...
en: Powdered spores drip from the strange plant...
ja: 見慣れない植物から、粉状の胞子がしたたっている……

key: Dump the Rage Powder for the Sleep Powder?
en: Dump the Rage Powder for the Sleep Powder?
ja: いかりのこなを捨てて、ねむりごなと交換しますか?

key: \PN used the Powder Vial.
en: \PN used the Powder Vial.
ja: \PNはこなのビンを使った。

key: Sleep Powder obtained!
en: Sleep Powder obtained!
ja: ねむりごなを手に入れた!

key: The Powder Vial is already full of Sleep Powder!
en: The Powder Vial is already full of Sleep Powder!
ja: こなのビンには、すでにねむりごなが入っている!

key: Use Sleep Powder on the Crustle?
en: Use Sleep Powder on the Crustle?
ja: イワパレスにねむりごなを使いますか?

key: Crustle fell asleep!
en: Crustle fell asleep!
ja: イワパレスは眠ってしまった!

key: The Crustle attacked!
en: The Crustle attacked!
ja: イワパレスが攻撃してきた!

key: Do you want to use the Rage Powder to wake Crustle up?
en: Do you want to use the Rage Powder to wake Crustle up?
ja: いかりのこなを使ってイワパレスを起こしますか?

key: The Crustle fled!
en: The Crustle fled!
ja: イワパレスは逃げてしまった!

key: A Crustle emerged from the nest!
en: A Crustle emerged from the nest!
ja: 巣からイワパレスが現れた!

key: The nest is currently empty...
en: The nest is currently empty...
ja: 巣は今、空っぽのようだ……

key: Huff... I need a break from hopping across all these rocks!
en: Huff... I need a break from hopping across all these rocks!
ja: はぁ……この岩場を飛び移り続けるのは、ちょっと休憩がいるな!

key: Although, I'll tell you what, I bet that I'm not half as beat up as that kid who was like thrown into the mountain.
en: Although, I'll tell you what, I bet that I'm not half as beat up as that kid who was like thrown into the mountain.
ja: とはいえ、あの山に投げ飛ばされてきたガキに比べりゃ、俺なんてまだまだマシだと思うぜ。

key: He landed somewhere in the south part of the Route.
en: He landed somewhere in the south part of the Route.
ja: そいつはこの道路の南のほうに落ちたみたいだ。

key: I hope he's all right.
en: I hope he's all right.
ja: 無事だといいけどな。

key: A man like me can't so easily jump over all these rocks. Let's do something else instead!
en: A man like me can't so easily jump over all these rocks. Let's do something else instead!
ja: 俺みたいな男は、こんな岩場をそう簡単には飛び越えられねえよ。別のことにしようぜ!

key: Urf. I think I'll go back to the rocks.
en: Urf. I think I'll go back to the rocks.
ja: うおっ。やっぱり岩場に戻るとするか。

key: Perhaps it's time to go home and retire.
en: Perhaps it's time to go home and retire.
ja: そろそろ家に帰って引退する頃合いかもな。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 14!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 14!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果データ14を手に入れた!

key: Info on Rocky Field now available!
en: Info on Rocky Field now available!
ja: ロッキーフィールドの情報が見られるようになった!

key: Dump the Sleep Powder for the Rage Powder?
en: Dump the Sleep Powder for the Rage Powder?
ja: ねむりごなを捨てて、いかりのこなと交換しますか?

key: Rage Powder obtained!
en: Rage Powder obtained!
ja: いかりのこなを手に入れた!

key: The Powder Vial is already full of Rage Powder!
en: The Powder Vial is already full of Rage Powder!
ja: こなのビンには、すでにいかりのこなが入っている!

key: Take care around the stones! Protect your powder!
en: Take care around the stones! Protect your powder!
ja: 石には気をつけろよ! 粉をしっかり守れ!

key: While you're at it, protect me from yourself!
en: While you're at it, protect me from yourself!
ja: ニック: ついでに、あんた自身からも俺を守ってくれよな!

key: We keep trying to make a nice shortcut for travelers on the east end but then we find that one of our keystones was just another Crustle...
en: We keep trying to make a nice shortcut for travelers on the east end but then we find that one of our keystones was just another Crustle...
ja: 東の端に旅人用のいい近道を作ろうとしてるんだけど、要になる石だと思ったら、それがまたイワパレスだったなんてことがよくあるんだよな……

key: All hail lord Goomy!
en: All hail lord Goomy!
ja: ヌメラ様万歳!

key: Get Goom't.
en: Get Goom't.
ja: ヌメラ: ヌメヌメ。

key: Goomy speaks and so shall we listen~
en: Goomy speaks and so shall we listen~
ja: ヌメラ様がお話しになった、ならば我らは耳を傾けるのみ～
